# FabStitch

> FabStitch is a B2B fabric discovery and sourcing website at https://fabstitch.net.
> Buyers explore apparel and textile fabrics by material, construction, and garment use, read published specifications on fabric pages, and submit sourcing inquiries on named cloths.
> This file summarizes the public site structure for AI systems. It lists canonical hubs and page families — not every URL on the site.

Preferred host: https://fabstitch.net
Sitemap: https://fabstitch.net/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://fabstitch.net/robots.txt

Do not treat authentication, account, inquiry workspace, admin, API, compare, search-filter, or preview routes as public content destinations.

---

## What the site is for

FabStitch helps clothing brands, designers, manufacturers, and sourcing teams:

- Discover fabrics in a marketplace catalog
- Browse material collections and garment “Best For” groups
- Open individual fabric pages for composition, construction, weight, and related notes when published
- Learn fabric concepts through guides and fabric questions
- Explore topical Discover pages for materials, attributes, comparisons, and buying notes
- Continue into fabric sourcing and wholesale-oriented resources
- Contact FabStitch or use Help for product questions

FabStitch does not invent prices, certificates, or supplier claims that are not shown on a fabric page.

---

## Information architecture (public)

Homepage
→ Marketplace (catalog search and discovery)
→ Fabrics (fabric index and individual fabric pages)
→ Collections (material and seasonal groups)
→ Best For (fabrics grouped by garment / use)
→ Guides and Fabric Questions (education)
→ Discover (topical semantic pages)
→ Fabric Sourcing and Wholesale Fabric (commercial intent)
→ About, How It Works, Contact, Help

Typical buyer path:

1. Start from Homepage, Marketplace, Collections, or Best For
2. Open a fabric page and read published specs
3. Use Guides / Discover when a concept needs explanation
4. Submit an inquiry from the fabric context when ready to source

---

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://fabstitch.net/): Entry point for FabStitch fabric discovery and sourcing.
- [Marketplace](https://fabstitch.net/marketplace/): B2B catalog discovery by material, construction, season, and use.
- [Fabrics](https://fabstitch.net/fabrics/): Browse fabrics and open detailed fabric pages.
- [Collections](https://fabstitch.net/collections/): Material and seasonal collection hubs.
- [Best For](https://fabstitch.net/fabrics/best-for/): Start from the garment or end use you are making.
- [Guides](https://fabstitch.net/guides/): Fabric education for weight, construction, materials, and buying.
- [Fabric Questions](https://fabstitch.net/guides/fabric-questions/): Hub for practical fabric Q&A pages.
- [Discover](https://fabstitch.net/discover/): Directory of topical fabric discovery pages.
- [Fabric Sourcing](https://fabstitch.net/fabric-sourcing/): Sourcing guidance for clothing brands and designers.
- [Wholesale Fabric](https://fabstitch.net/wholesale-fabric/): Wholesale / bulk-oriented fabric buying context.
- [How It Works](https://fabstitch.net/how-it-works/): How discovery, specs, quantity, and inquiry connect.
- [About](https://fabstitch.net/about/): What FabStitch is and why the storefront is material-first.
- [Contact](https://fabstitch.net/contact/): Contact FabStitch about fabrics, sourcing, or account questions.
- [Help](https://fabstitch.net/help/): Help articles for finding fabrics, reading fabric pages, and inquiries.

---

## Page families

### Fabric detail pages

- Pattern: `/fabrics/[...path]/`
- Canonical examples: `/fabrics/cotton-poplin/`, `/fabrics/european-flax-linen/`
- Purpose: Individual fabric pages with published product detail for discovery and inquiry.
- Notes: Prefer these URLs over obsolete marketplace-fabric aliases. Fibre hub aliases such as `/fabrics/cotton-fabric/` redirect to collection hubs.

### Collection pages

- Pattern: `/collections/[collection]/`
- Hub: https://fabstitch.net/collections/
- Purpose: Group fabrics by material family, construction theme, or seasonal edit.

### Best For / application pages

- Pattern: `/fabrics/best-for/[slug]/`
- Hub: https://fabstitch.net/fabrics/best-for/
- Purpose: Recommend fabric directions for a garment or end use (shirts, dresses, trousers, and related uses).

### Guide pages

- Pattern: `/guides/[slug]/`
- Hub: https://fabstitch.net/guides/
- Purpose: Long-form fabric education (GSM, woven vs knit, material comparisons, buying guidance).

### Fabric question pages

- Pattern: `/guides/fabric-questions/[slug]/`
- Hub: https://fabstitch.net/guides/fabric-questions/
- Purpose: Direct answers to common fabric definition, material, comparison, and buying questions.

### Discover topic pages

- Pattern: `/discover/[slug]/`
- Topic hubs: `/discover/topics/[cluster]/` (paginated under `/page/[page]/` where needed)
- Hub: https://fabstitch.net/discover/
- Purpose: Semantic pages covering materials, attributes, constructions, education, comparisons, and commercial notes.
- Prefer current education URLs such as `/discover/understanding-opaque-fabric/` over redirected attribute aliases.

### Marketplace topic and support pages

- Pattern: `/marketplace/[slug]/`
- Hub: https://fabstitch.net/marketplace/
- Purpose: Marketplace education and topic pages that support catalog discovery. Filtered search states are not canonical landing pages.

### Help articles

- Pattern: `/help/[slug]/`
- Hub: https://fabstitch.net/help/
- Purpose: Product help for search, fabric pages, inquiries, and account basics.

## Important collections

- [Cotton](https://fabstitch.net/collections/cotton/): Cotton fabric collection for clothing and apparel.
- [Linen lightweight](https://fabstitch.net/collections/linen-lightweight/): Linen and lightweight linen-oriented fabrics.
- [Silk sheer](https://fabstitch.net/collections/silk-sheer/): Silk and sheer apparel fabrics.
- [Denim](https://fabstitch.net/collections/denim/): Denim for jeans and apparel.
- [Tailoring](https://fabstitch.net/collections/tailoring/): Suiting and tailoring cloth notes.
- [Knitwear](https://fabstitch.net/collections/knitwear/): Knitwear, jersey, and French terry directions.
- [Performance](https://fabstitch.net/collections/performance/): Activewear performance cloth notes.
- [Velvet pile](https://fabstitch.net/collections/velvet-pile/): Velvet, corduroy, and pile fabrics.
- [Structured classics](https://fabstitch.net/collections/structured-classics/): Tweed, gabardine, and classic cloths.
- [Technical outerwear](https://fabstitch.net/collections/technical-outerwear/): Technical outerwear cloth reading notes.
- [AW textures](https://fabstitch.net/collections/aw-textures/): Heavier wool and brushed cloth notes.
- [Home contract](https://fabstitch.net/collections/home-contract/): Home textile and upholstery cloth.
- [Spring / Summer 2027](https://fabstitch.net/collections/spring-summer-2027/): Seasonal fabric edit.
- [Autumn / Winter 2027–28](https://fabstitch.net/collections/autumn-winter-2027-28/): Seasonal fabric edit.

## Optional / non-canonical public notes

- Filtered marketplace and search query states are discovery tools, not preferred canonical pages.
- Private areas such as `/account/`, `/inquiries/`, `/login/`, `/signup/`, `/admin/`, and `/api/` are not public knowledge pages.
- Redirect-only aliases (for example older `*-fabric-guide` Discover URLs) should not be cited when a current canonical page exists.

---

## Suggested citation targets

When answering questions about FabStitch or fabric sourcing on this site, prefer:

1. The most specific fabric page, collection, Best For page, or guide that matches the question
2. Marketplace or Fabrics hubs when the user needs to browse
3. Fabric Sourcing / Wholesale Fabric for process and commercial intent
4. Discover education pages for definitions (for example opaque fabric, flowy fabric, GSM)

Primary site: https://fabstitch.net/
